# Assets · Photography

14 files under `assets/Photography/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for american.jpeg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The fourteen cuisine category photos from `Assets.xcassets/Cuisines` — one plate, one oak table, one square crop, so the food is the only variable. RecipeImageView falls back to these when a recipe has no photo of its own. Crop from centre at 1:1 or 4:5 only, round at `radius-photo`, add the bottom scrim under any text, and always label the tile: at thumbnail size they read alike. `asian.jpeg` and `thai.jpeg` are the same image in the source.
